definitions.explanation: A doctor who specializes in treating teeth and gums; also refers to a dental clinic.

examples.japanese: {歯医者|はいしゃ}に{行|い}かなければなりません。
examples.english: I have to go to the dentist.

examples.japanese: {歯医者|はいしゃ}で{虫歯|むしば}を{治|なお}しました。
examples.english: I had my cavity treated at the dentist.

examples.japanese: {歯医者|はいしゃ}が{怖|こわ}い。

notes:
{歯医者|はいしゃ} refers to both the dentist and the dental office.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}に{行|い}く: to go to the dentist
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}で{治療|ちりょう}する: to get treatment at the dentist
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}を{予約|よやく}する: to make a dentist appointment

DENTAL TERMS:
- {虫歯|むしば}: cavity, tooth decay
- {歯|は}を{抜|ぬ}く: to extract a tooth
- {歯|は}を{磨|みが}く: to brush teeth
- {歯科|しか}: dentistry
- {歯科医|しかい}: dentist (formal)

Note: {歯医者|はいしゃ} is casual; {歯科医|しかい} is the formal term.
